name: Brand EQ
author: Urban Pixels

sections.description:
Brand EQ is an AI brand identity and content assistant from Urban Pixels. Build a BrandMatrix from your brand’s values, personality, audience and onboarding answers, then use it to guide blog posts, pages and WooCommerce product descriptions.

  • Create and manage your BrandMatrix.
  • Generate or rewrite content with your brand context.
  • Score content against your BrandMatrix.
  • Restore backed-up content after supported generation workflows.

A Brand EQ service account/API key and an Internet connection are required for BrandMatrix generation, scoring and service-backed prompts. The free service plan and optional paid plans have different service limits. An optional hosted-service trial does not remove access to the free plan when it ends. See Brand EQ plans for current limits and pricing.

For generation through your own AI account, configure a compatible provider through WordPress Connectors and approve Brand EQ if prompted. Provider usage may incur separate charges. Managed generation depends on your Brand EQ service plan. Optional Pro add-ons are installed separately by the site administrator; this plugin does not download or install them.

Always review generated content for accuracy and suitability before publishing.

External services

Brand EQ service (Urban Pixels)

This plugin connects to https://brandeq-api.urbanpixels.com/v1 for account registration, onboarding brand suggestions, BrandMatrix generation, content scoring, generation requests, background-job status, service capabilities and trial activation. The service performs the brand/AI processing; it is not only a license check.

When you register, the plugin sends the submitted email address, website URL and marketing opt-in choice. Authenticated requests send your Brand EQ API key. Depending on the action, requests also send onboarding answers, brand information, BrandMatrix elements, post/page/product titles and content, tags and generation/image preferences. Trial activation sends your site URL. Configured sites may contact the service in the background to retrieve capabilities and complete queued jobs.

The Brand EQ service processes requests on Urban Pixels’ infrastructure. To generate content it may send your prompts, brand information and content to the AI model providers it uses: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Amazon Web Services. Which provider handles a request depends on the model and your plan. Their terms and privacy policies:

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/business-terms/ and https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms and https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Amazon Web Services: https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms/ and https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/

Do not submit confidential or personal content unless you are authorized to share it with the service. Brand EQ is a brand of Urban Pixels.

  • Service: https://brandeq.urbanpixels.com/
  • Terms: https://www.urbanpixels.com/terms/
  • Privacy: https://www.urbanpixels.com/privacy/

Your configured AI provider

When you choose generation through WordPress Connectors, the WordPress AI client sends the generation prompt, brand context and relevant content to the provider you configure and approve. Requests occur when generating content; the provider receives the data needed to answer the prompt. The provider plugin manages credentials and its own connection. Review the terms and privacy policy of the provider you select, for example:

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/business-terms/ and https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms and https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Brand EQ on WordPress 7.1 or newer with PHP 7.4 or newer.
  2. Open Brand EQ in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Register for the Brand EQ service or enter your existing API key.
  4. Complete the onboarding questions and generate your BrandMatrix.
  5. To use your own AI provider, install/configure a compatible provider plugin in WordPress Connectors and approve Brand EQ in Tools > AI Connector Approval when requested.
  6. Use the Brand EQ controls on posts, pages or WooCommerce products. WooCommerce is needed only for product features.

Deactivate any self-hosted Brand EQ/Shoppyr copy before activating this WordPress.org version. Both copies share settings and must not run simultaneously.
sections.faq:
Is a paid Brand EQ plan required?

No paid plan is required, but a Brand EQ service account is. The plugin is a client for the hosted Brand EQ service (Urban Pixels), which runs our proprietary brand-analysis models on our own infrastructure, so a free Brand EQ account and API key are required to use the plugin — the same way account-based services like Akismet work. Registration is free.

The plugin itself contains no locked, disabled, or trial-limited code; every feature shipped in the plugin is fully available. Paid plans meter hosted service requests (generations, BrandMatrix runs, and similar). The Brand EQ API enforces those limits when it processes a request. Local editing, retrieval of supported BrandMatrix fields, and use of a configured WordPress AI provider are not restricted by the Brand EQ plan. A free account provides a limited, ongoing BrandMatrix and service usage: the service builds your BrandMatrix and generates brand-aware prompts that your chosen AI provider uses to produce on-brand content. The free service returns six BrandMatrix fields: Mission, Vision, Values, Brand Personality, Target Audience, and Brand Promise, plus identifying metadata. Accounts with the full BrandMatrix service entitlement can receive 15 analytical fields. The WordPress.org plugin processes six analytical fields even if the API returns a full Pro matrix. A separately distributed Pro add-on extends the field processing. Previously saved add-on fields are retained when the add-on is inactive.

For content generation you can either use Brand EQ’s managed generation or connect your own AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, etc.) through WordPress AI Connectors with your own API key, so you are not dependent on a paid Brand EQ plan for generation. The optional hosted-service trial adds temporary managed capacity; when it ends, the plugin’s code keeps working and you continue on the free tier or with your own AI provider.

Does this plugin work offline?

No. Brand EQ service operations and configured AI provider generation require external network connections.

Is WooCommerce required?

Only for product-description features. Blog and page workflows do not require WooCommerce.

Why is my AI connector blocked?

Check that the provider is configured and that Brand EQ is approved in Tools > AI Connector Approval. The plugin does not grant itself approval.

Where is the JavaScript source?

Editable JavaScript/Sass and Webpack configuration are included in the plugin. See SOURCES.txt for locations, third-party sources and build instructions.
sections.changelog:
1.1.19

  • Fix: AI replies that arrive as a markdown code block are now converted into Gutenberg blocks instead of being saved as one code block.
  • Fix: an AI job that returns no text no longer overwrites the post.
  • Fix: quote paragraphs were wrapped twice.
  • Fix: an unexpected MatrixScore value from the service can no longer break the post editor screen.
  • Security: generated content is passed through WordPress’s post sanitizer before it is saved, and the code-block language is restricted to safe characters.

1.1.18

  • Remove local plan and cached-quota gates; hosted service limits are enforced by the Brand EQ API.
  • Process six analytical BrandMatrix fields in the base plugin; provide an extension filter for separately distributed add-ons. Preserve previously stored add-on data.
  • Allow configured AI providers regardless of service plan.
  • Enqueue onboarding, next steps and editor scripts/styles through WordPress.
  • Stop inspecting AI connector credentials and update Parsedown to 1.8.0.

1.1.17

  • Free plan now includes 5 BrandMatrix generations per month (previously 3).
  • When you reach your monthly BrandMatrix limit on the free plan, the generate step now shows an upgrade prompt instead of starting a request that can’t complete.

1.1.12

  • Requires WordPress 7.1 (uses the WordPress AI client).
  • Clear messages when BrandMatrix generation fails or your plan doesn’t allow a model.
  • Prompts you to approve Brand EQ in AI Connector Approval when your AI provider hasn’t approved it yet.
  • Security: permission checks and nonces on all Brand EQ REST routes; input sanitized and output escaped throughout.
  • Tailwind, Tagify and the jQuery UI theme are now bundled instead of loaded from a CDN.
  • Fixed product description jobs not being processed by the background queue.
  • Fixed finished jobs staying queued and polling indefinitely.
  • Text domain is now brand-eq.
